technique_name: Write a 100-word biographical note about Alexander Hamilton.
description: Alexander Hamilton was a Founding Father of the United States and an important political thinker in American history. Born on the Caribbean island of Nevis, Hamilton moved to New York in 1772 and became a vocal advocate for revolution. After the Revolutionary War, Hamilton was a major figure of the Constitutional Ratifying Convention and became the first United States Secretary of Treasury.
